_comment: 1. The sheet has NO alpha channel — its background is opaque near-white
(254,255,254), about 50% of the image. Props must have it keyed out by
flood fill from their own border, never by a colour threshold, or the
white highlights inside the art get eaten too.
2. It is a CONTACT SHEET, not an indexed atlas. Terrain is hand-painted
patches and cliffs are whole formations, so there is no uniform grid to
index and no autotile matrix. Terrain tiles below were cut from clean
interior areas and each was verified by tiling it 4x4 and looking for
